name: Daringer
sources: Ambrosia for Heads — Daringer & Beat Butcha on producing without samples (https://ambrosiaforheads.com/2019/12/griselda-daringer-beat-butcha-no-samples-wwcd/)
notes: The Griselda house sound, and this model is defined by subtraction. "Lean and dry", "no reverb, no fills", "levels and top-end deliberately restrained", "negative space is structural" — so `velocityTiers` is the lowest on this axis, `percs.lanes` is emptied entirely (the genre gives five lanes; he uses none), `melody.densityPerBar` tops out at 3 with `emptyBarBias` 0.3, and the tempo band is the slowest here at 78–92. The harmony is "often one sustained chord", which is why `impliedByRiff` is set and the chord part's variety comes from `chordDurationBeats`, three `harmonicRhythm` values and a 36-semitone voicing register rather than from progressions he does not play. ⚠ Two engine floors are visible here and both are named honestly. `hihat.continuous` is false and `fillDensity` is 0.28 — the research says "hats sparse or absent", but a model that declares a hat block must produce hats on every seed, so 0.28 is the floor rather than a reading. `fills` at 8/16 is the sparsest the fill grammar reaches; the research says no fills at all. ⚠ `medium` because the research rates it medium-high: the gear list is first-person, the numbers are not. The specific inferred parameter is `melody.emptyBarBias` — "negative space is structural" is a philosophy, and 0.3 is this author's number for it. ⚠ The i–VI family is INFERRED; the research names static i and occasional i–iv. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 42 to 39 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 40 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 3. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 663 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: styles 3, densityRatio 0.5, melody density [1,5]. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2,4], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 927/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,5] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 927/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.3 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 927/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
